comment: A6 screening survivors (variants/screening.md). `order` is the confirmation batch order (batches of 3): the design candidates first, then the clear wins in screening order, the borderline survivors last. `separate` is confirmed but kept out of variants/combo.patch. Consumed by scripts/prepare.mjs --variants and scripts/make-stage.mjs (@variants survivors=).

dropped.pipe-steps-loop: no win on its target flow (geomean 1.020 in both rotations)
dropped.pipe-hoist-step-count: no win on its target flow (1.000 / 1.002)
dropped.purryfromlazy-slice: no win on its target flow (1.014 / 1.013)
dropped.pipe-steps-if-lazy: tier 1 slowdown in both rotations (G3 pipe(x) x64 2.6x, pipe(x, arrow) x64 1.4x, G1b XS two-step pipes 1.10-1.13: the bigger pipe body stops being inlined into callers)
dropped.sentinel-pure: no effect on the published dist (tsdown strips the annotation)
dropped.identity-controls: superseded by identity-controls-v2 (same design plus one typeof-symbol guard): in the v1/v2/branch screen (3 rotations, T1G + targets, scale 0.25) v1 is slower than the branch on 17 tier 1 entries in every run (map-heavy pipes at S/C 1.09-1.30, unique at XS/S 1.09-1.13), v2 on none; v2/v1 tier 1 weighted geomean 0.930

choices: pipe-single-step-runs over pipe-on-demand-segments (alternatives for the same pipe.ts lines; single-step-runs contains on-demand): tier 1 screen geomean 0.969 vs 0.970, a tie within noise decided by the rule (better tier 1)
single-array-index-loop, single-skip-identity and single-skip-first merged by hand: the identity check and the skip-first case order went into single-array-index-loop collect() helper
datalast-direct-props and datalast-arity-closures merged by hand: createDataLast() returns a function typed with the optional lazy props, which are then written directly
requiredata-direct-write, requiredata-positional-index, map-callback-as-evaluator (canReadData) and sentinel-module (sentinel moved to its own module) merged by hand in requireData.ts
purry-arity-calls and lazy-args-arity add the same callWithArguments.ts (+ test): kept once
pipe-isarray-first and single-array-index-loop add the same lone-step generator test, and pipe-array-index-loop the same naturals() helper: kept once
identity-controls-v2 stays separate (design alternative; conflicts with the combo in pipe.ts, processSingleLazyStep.ts and semantically with map-callback-as-evaluator)
combo.verified: variants/.verify/combo.log: runtime tests with 100% coverage, prop, types, tsc, eslint, prettier, ASCII
